intro: Soft and stylish, this cotton throw with a chic sand zigzag pattern brings warmth and texture to any space. Blending practicality with design, it’s perfect for adding subtle elegance to your decor.

features.title: Soft as whispers, light as air
features.text: Crafted from soft, durable cotton, this throw offers exceptional breathability and comfort, ensuring it becomes a beloved staple in your home.

features.title: A versatile design that pairs effortlessly
features.text: Its unique zig-zag design in calming sand tones brings texture and elegance to your living space, perfectly complementing both contemporary and classic interiors.

features.title: Lightweight comfort, heavy on style
features.text: Beyond its decorative appeal, this throw provides cosy warmth on cool nights and acts as a protective and comfortable layer for your furniture.

care: Gentle Machine Wash, Do Not Bleach, Tumble Dry Low, Iron If Needed, Do Not Dry clean
name: 50x70 Cotton Throw
